scope: Researcher-authored Rust-inspired propositional controls, NOT extracted code contracts or independent labels
semantics: Enumerate every Boolean assignment; restrict to premise-satisfying worlds. All hypothesis true => entailment; all false => contradiction; mixed => neutral. Reject unsatisfiable premise.
inference: Use previous pinned local NLI model and CPU settings, two passes, no text changes after measurement; 3-way argmax and binary collapse both reported. Formula/labels never sent to model.
limits: English-to-formula alignment is a human review assumption, not proven by truth-table enumeration. Variables refer to one specified invocation or one specified module, not temporal logic. No complete Rust semantics or production claim.
